Resumes.

To tailor.

The strongest open fits that still need a tailored resume: saved roles first, then roles naming your graduation year, then other strong fits. Copy the brief into your resume session, build the file, and either upload it to the private repo (it appears below and on the card) or mark the card done.

Sync with GitHub
Same token as the radar and tracker. Finished resumes are read from a resumes/ folder next to state.json in that repo; Done / Skip marks are written into state.json.

Finished files.

Everything in the private repo's resumes/ folder, opened through your token. Name a file <slug>.pdf (the brief gives the slug) and it attaches to its role above; anything else is listed here.

Connect sync under Data to list your files.
Nothing here is sent to any company; files stay in your private repo. Source: TheBurntWaffl3/jadar.
